faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Project Research Engineer position at IIT Guwahati?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online for the Project Research Engineer position at IIT Guwahati is 12-08-2026. It is advisable to submit your application well before this date.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Project Research Engineer post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies for the Project Research Engineer post at IIT Guwahati.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Research Engineer role?
faq.answer: Candidates need to have an M.Tech./M.E./M.S. with 3 years of experience or a Ph.D. in relevant engineering disciplines as per the specific post requirements.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Project Research Engineer position?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 70000 per month.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is strictly online through the official website of IIT Guwahati.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for the Project Research Engineer post?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Project Research Engineer recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve an Online Interview for the eligible candidates.

faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section of this article, under the 'Official Notification PDF' link.
